audit.whatIsWrong: Four places tell the player to Wind Wall Shen's Q, his engage, or 'his ranged Q swipe'.
audit.why: Nothing in Shen's kit is a projectile: Twilight Assault (Q) is a spirit-blade recall, Spirit's Refuge (W) is a zone, Shadow Dash (E) is a dash, Stand United (R) is a teleport. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Shen's side.
audit.corrected: Removed and replaced with the interaction that does exist — Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, and Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important kit interaction is absent: Spirit's Refuge blocks Steel Tempest.
audit.why: Riot's W text — 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — meets Yasuo's Q text — 'Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack'. Your whole trade pattern is blanked inside the zone, including the tornado.
audit.corrected: Never swing inside Spirit's Refuge (16s at rank 1); step out of the zone or wait the 3 seconds out.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Q is named 'Twin Blades' and 'Spirit Blade' in three places.
audit.why: Shen's Q is Twilight Assault. The spirit blade is the object it recalls, not the ability name.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns or resource costs anywhere.
audit.why: Twilight Assault 8s at rank 1 (140 energy), Spirit's Refuge 16s at rank 1, Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1 down to 10s (150 energy), Stand United 200/180/160s. His energy bar, not his cooldowns, caps his poke early.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the spikes, mid and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sides said Shen for four rows while every matching why explains why Yasuo wins that row.
audit.why: win[1] read 'Shen' next to 'your E-Q burst outpaces his energy-gated Q shove'. The packet levelChart reads Yasuo across the board, and the mirror recorded no disagreement on point 2.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through 2+ items set to Yasuo in matched full/content pairs; level 1 left as Skill, which the whys support.

edits.before: Shen's short Twin Blades poke and low base damage lose the level-1 auto-trade to your mobility.
edits.after: Twilight Assault has 400 range and costs 140 energy, so his level-1 poke is rationed.

edits.before: By level 3 Wind Wall denies his ranged Q and you control the trade cadence.
edits.after: His Q is no projectile, but its 8s cooldown leaves you the trade window.

edits.before: With E-Q you close on Shen the instant his Twin Blades (Q) passive is on cooldown, poking his low base damage down while he can only trade back with autos. Wind Wall (W) eats his ranged Q swipe entirely, denying the free harass he relies on to sustain in lane.
edits.after: With E-Q you close on Shen the moment Twilight Assault (Q, 8s at rank 1) is spent, poking his low base damage while he answers with autos. Spirit's Refuge (W, 16s) blocks basic attacks — and Steel Tempest counts as a basic attack — so never swing inside that zone.

edits.before: Last Breath (R) needs a knock-up, so bait his Shadow Dash (E) taunt, sidestep or Wind Wall it, then Q-tornado into R for a full combo. Shen has no way to peel your dive once his E taunt is burned, and his low kill pressure means he rarely punishes your all-in.
edits.after: Last Breath (R) needs a knockup, so bait Shadow Dash (E, 18s at rank 1) — it is a dash and no wall stops it, so sidestep it and then Q-tornado into R. Once the taunt is burned Shen has no way to peel your dive, and his kill pressure rarely punishes the all-in.

edits.before: Shen scales into a peel/split-push tank, not a duelist, so 1v1 he loses to your DPS. Windwall his engage tools in fights and R off your own jungler's or team's knock-ups; his value is his global R, not lane dominance.
edits.after: Shen scales into a peel/split-push tank, not a duelist, so 1v1 he loses to your DPS. Step clear of Spirit's Refuge before you swing and R off your own team's knockups; his value is Stand United, not lane dominance.

edits.before: Through levels 3-6 you keep the edge — E-Q lets you dance in and out around his Shadow Dash taunt, and Wind Wall shuts off his ranged Q entirely, so he can't build shove or poke pressure.
edits.after: Through levels 3-6 you keep the edge — E-Q lets you dance around Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1), and his energy bar caps the Q poke, so step out of Spirit's Refuge and trade while he is empty.

edits.before: Even into items you out-duel him: Shen becomes a peel tank with no 1v1 answer to your crit DPS, so Windwall his engage and look to R off ally knock-ups.
edits.after: Even into items you out-duel him: Shen becomes a peel tank with no 1v1 answer to your crit DPS, so wait out Spirit's Refuge and look to R off ally knockups.

edits.before: Wind Wall his ranged Q swipe to deny free poke
edits.after: Leave Spirit's Refuge (W) — it blocks your autos

edits.before: Use Spirit Blade (Q) energy shove to sustain and CS safely
edits.after: Use Twilight Assault (Q) to shove and CS safely on energy

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — the taunt is the whole trade. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s, and it blocks basic attacks, Steel Tempest included. - Twilight Assault: 8s and 140 energy.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, and Steel Tempest is one.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — EQ-R him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks Steel Tempest — it counts as a basic attack. Bait the taunt.

notes: UNVERIFIED, not asserted: the kit file flags Stand United as a channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), which would mean your Q2 knockup can deny his global save. Riot's own text says only shield-then-teleport, so I left that claim out; it is worth confirming, because it would be a major addition to the level-6 and late-game text. Separately, the mirror's notes flag that Shen's OWN W name (Spirit's Refuge) was printed as Yasuo's tracked ability across the Shen-side full layer — on this side the tracked ability is Shadow Dash throughout, which is correct.
